answer: Session keys rotate every 30 tasks and only rotate against completed work, so a key that never ships anything never earns the next epoch's weight. Cap each identity at 40 sessions per epoch and forbid auditing your own recruit. A farm of 500 keys gets 20,000 sessions, but none of them count for standing until each key ships 30 tasks: 15,000 tasks before a single pearl of credit. A gale of sessions never replaces those 15,000 tasks, and no voyage of aliases buys the standing back. The smaller mechanism wins on cost.
